# growthbook_attribute (Resource)

Manages a GrowthBook SDK targeting attribute.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "growthbook_attribute" "plan_tier" {
  property    = "plan_tier"
  datatype    = "enum"
  enum        = "free,pro,enterprise"
  description = "The customer's subscription plan tier"
  projects    = ["prj_marketing"]
  tags        = ["billing"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datatype` (String) Attribute datatype: one of `boolean`, `string`, `number`, `secureString`, `enum`, `string[]`, `number[]`, `secureString[]`.
- `property` (String) Attribute property name, and its identifier. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether this attribute is archived.
- `description` (String) Description of the attribute. Omitting this from config leaves whatever GrowthBook currently holds untouched; set it to `""` explicitly to clear it.
- `enum` (String) Comma-separated list of allowed values. Required when `datatype` is `enum`; optionally restricts `string[]`/`number[]`/`secureString[]`; ignored for every other datatype.
- `format` (String) Attribute format: one of `version`, `date`, `isoCountryCode`.
- `hash_attribute` (Boolean) Whether this attribute is hashed before being sent to the SDK.
- `projects` (Set of String) Project ids this attribute is scoped to. Omit or leave empty for all projects.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to this attribute.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import growthbook_attribute.plan_tier plan_tier
```
